description: This file contains unit tests for JSON serialization and deserialization of various objects in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cluster package, specifically testing the behavior of JsonJsonifiableSerializer and CborJsonifiableSerializer implementations. It includes parameterized tests for serialization strategies of Thing commands and DittoHeaders objects, using JUnit and accompanying test classes.

classes.description: Main test class for serializer serialization/deserialization tests.

classes.name: SharedJsonifiableSerializerTest.ThingCommandsStrategy
classes.description: Nested class testing serialization strategies for Thing command objects.

classes.name: SharedJsonifiableSerializerTest.DittoHeadersStrategy
classes.description: Nested class testing serialization strategies for DittoHeaders objects.
